content.text:
Blink and Cut both change Opacity, Blink three times starting at 1 s and Cut once at 3 s. Right now each one fades between its keys. Is either one meant to snap on and off instead?

I can't see inside the Seal precomp yet, so I'm not saying it's fine.

Is anything here meant to snap, like a blink, an on/off or a cut?

Okay, Blink's Opacity it is. At 1.2 s Blink is about half see-through, so right now it fades instead of snapping. A hold keeps the value until the next key and then jumps, the way Dot 1 already jumps at 0.5 s.

Select the key at the start of each pair (1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s) and choose Animation > Toggle Hold Keyframe (⌃⌥⌘H), or right-click the key. Hold Blink's three pairs and say done.

I held one for you: Blink's Opacity key at 1 s. Blink now stays fully visible right up to 1.4 s, as this frame from just before shows, and then jumps to Opacity 0 and vanishes there. Edit > Undo reverses it if you want.

The 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs are yours; say done.

That passes. You held the 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs yourself, on top of the one I did at 1 s, so Blink now snaps all the way through.

Is there a move here that should run at constant speed, like a steady spin?
